generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: flowers complete, regular, 5-merous; sepals imbricated; stamens 10, filaments somewhat dilated and united at base; ovary superior, 5-celled; styles 5, distinct.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 332 Oxalidaceae: herbs or undershrubs; leaves alternate or basal, digitately or pinnately compound, rarely simple by loss of leaflets, the leaflets often folding at night; stipules absent; fruit a capsule.
